complexity.notes: Index recovery via nums.index/nums.pop is convoluted and each call is O(n); storing (value, index) pairs before sorting, or using a hash map for the classic O(n) one-pass approach, would be cleaner and faster. The final sorted() on a two-element list is harmless but adds clutter.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array and uses a two-pointer scan to find the pair summing to target, then recovers the original indices via list.index (with a pop-based workaround for duplicate values). Dominated by the O(n log n) sort; the index lookups add only O(n).
